description.value: Heritage Inn is a former Best Western hotel situated in Hope, BC, at the junction of several major routes including the Trans-Canada and Crowsnest highways — a natural overnight stop for long-distance cyclists. The property is surrounded by the dramatic scenery of the Fraser Canyon and Cascade Mountains, and Hope itself has a quirky claim to fame as a location used in numerous Hollywood films. Rooms include standard amenities such as microwave, mini fridge, and free high-speed internet.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Heritage Inn is an operational hotel in Hope, BC (formerly a Best Western), and corroborates the OSM phone number and address. The website mentions 'free high speed internet' confirming the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, bike procedures, laundry, tools, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all cycling-relevant criteria remain null.
concerns: Website is very sparse (1014 bytes) and may not represent the full range of property amenities — a phone or email inquiry is recommended.
Minor address formatting discrepancy: OSM uses 'Old Hope-Princeton Way' (hyphenated); website uses 'Old Hope Princeton Way' (no hyphen). Likely the same street.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate, operating accommodation at a strategically useful location for touring cyclists in Hope, BC, but neither the website nor OSM tags confirm any bike-specific amenities — particularly the required criteria of secure overnight bike storage and staff familiarity with bike procedures. Direct outreach is needed before including in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also lists a toll-free number (1-888-869-6577) and email (heritageinn@telus.net) not present in OSM tags.
